card.name: Decimal point inside numbers in tables
card.fires_on: The period used as a decimal point between digits, mostly in dose and measurement tables, as in 0.6 mg or 1.8 kg. It also fires on dots in version-style numbers.

modes.label: Dose table decimals
modes.description: The decimal point after a single digit such as 0 or 1 in dose amounts with mg, mL or kg.

modes.label: Data table decimals
modes.description: The decimal point inside numbers in crowded rows of figures and ranges.

modes.label: Dotted number strings
modes.description: A dot inside an IP-like or section-like number string.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and multilingual, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks the decimal point in numbers inside dense dose and measurement tables.
